The '''2026 City of Lincoln Council election''' will take place on 7 May 2026 to elect members of [[City of Lincoln Council]] in [[Lincolnshire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|first= |last= |author-link= |first2= |last2= |author2-link= |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections |pages= |date=16 February 2026 |access-date=16 February 2026 |work= |publisher=Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG) |place= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260216154427/https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |archive-date=16 February 2026 }}</ref> This was on the same day as other [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]].

Changes 2024–2026:
*January 2025: Sue Burke (Labour) dies – by-election held April 2025<ref>{{cite news |last1=McKenna |first1=David |title=Tributes paid to two-time mayor of Lincoln Sue Burke |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3weg8w4n77o |access-date=19 March 2026 |work=BBC News |date=7 January 2025}}</ref>
*April 2025: Sarah Uldall (Liberal Democrats) gains by-election from Labour<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Park Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/17726/#2025-04-03 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=19 March 2026}}</ref>
*February 2026: Biff Bean (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Waller |first1=Jamie |title=Lincoln councillor quits Labour and says 'most people are sick of all parties' |url=https://www.lincolnshirelive.co.uk/news/lincoln-news/lincoln-councillor-quits-labour-says-10566017 |access-date=19 March 2026 |work=Lincolnshire Live |date=10 October 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*February 2026: Neil Murray (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Lane |first1=Jessica |title=Labour ‘misled’ voters on election delay, says Lincoln councillor |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwygzrg4ypmo |access-date=19 March 2026 |work=BBC News |date=4 February 2026}}</ref>
